diff --git a/scripts/release.py b/scripts/release.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..53a41f4d3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/release.py
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+import argparse
+import re
+import sys
+from datetime import date
+from pathlib import Path
+
+VERSION_FILE = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+LATEST_CHANGES_HEADER = "## Latest Changes"
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Prepare a new release.")
+    parser.add_argument("version", help="The new version number (e.g., 0.136.4)")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    new_version = args.version
+    today = date.today().isoformat()
+
+    # Update version in fastapi/__init__.py
+    if not VERSION_FILE.exists():
+        print(f"Error: {VERSION_FILE} not found.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    content = VERSION_FILE.read_text()
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = ".*"', f'__version__ = "{new_version}"', content)
+    VERSION_FILE.write_text(new_content)
+    print(f"Updated {VERSION_FILE} to {new_version}")
+
+    # Update release notes
+    if not RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.exists():
+        print(f"Error: {RELEASE_NOTES_FILE} not found.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    lines = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
+
+    latest_changes_idx = -1
+    next_header_idx = -1
+
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if line.strip() == LATEST_CHANGES_HEADER:
+            latest_changes_idx = i
+        elif latest_changes_idx != -1 and line.startswith("## "):
+            next_header_idx = i
+            break
+
+    if latest_changes_idx == -1:
+        print(f"Error: Could not find {LATEST_CHANGES_HEADER} in {RELEASE_NOTES_FILE}")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    # Extract content of Latest Changes
+    end_idx = next_header_idx if next_header_idx != -1 else len(lines)
+    changes_content = lines[latest_changes_idx + 1 : end_idx]
+
+    # Create new version header
+    new_version_header = f"## {new_version} ({today})\n"
+    
+    # Construct new lines
+    # Keep everything up to and including Latest Changes header
+    new_lines = lines[:latest_changes_idx + 1]
+    
+    # Add a newline for spacing if needed
+    if not (len(new_lines) > 0 and new_lines[-1].endswith("\n")):
+        new_lines[-1] += "\n"
+    new_lines.append("\n")
+    
+    # Add the new version header and the extracted changes
+    new_lines.append(new_version_header)
+    new_lines.extend(changes_content)
+    
+    # Add the rest of the file
+    if next_header_idx != -1:
+        new_lines.extend(lines[next_header_idx:])
+    
+    RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.write_text("".join(new_lines))
+    print(f"Updated {RELEASE_NOTES_FILE} with version {new_version}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
